chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Dawud ibn al-Husayn, from Ya'qub ibn Shu'ayb, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

I said to him: A man from those who claim our authority continues to say to one upon whom Allah has bestowed Islam: 'O Nabati (person of mixed Arab/non-Arab descent).' He (peace be upon him) said: We are the People of the House, and the Nabati is from the progeny of Ibrahim. Indeed, there are two types of Nabati from the Nabat: Water and Clay, and nothing is detrimental in their progeny. A people who extracted/derived knowledge, so they are us.

key_terms.أَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ: The People of the House (Ahl al-Bayt)
key_terms.النَّبَطِيُّ: Nabati (one of mixed Arab/non-Arab descent or specifically from the Nabat)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Nabati' in the hadith of Imam al-Sadiq regarding the Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) redefines 'Nabati' not as a derogatory term for non-Arabs, but as a title of honor for the Ahl al-Bayt, who are the true descendants of Ibrahim composed of 'water and clay.' He distinguishes two types of 'Nabati': the general lineage and the specific group who 'extracted' (istanbatu) divine knowledge, thereby identifying the Ahl al-Bayt as the latter. This etymological interpretation underscores their unique spiritual authority and connection to the primordial elements of creation.

en.basel-kadem: 72.	With this chain of narrators, from Salama, from Umar bin Sa’eed bin Kuthaym, from his brother, Mu’ammar, from Muhammed bin Ali, peace be upon them both, that he said:
We are Arabs, our party is from us and the rest of the people are hamaj or habaj. He said: I said: And what is hamaj? He said: Flies. I said: And what is habaj? He said: Bugs.
